control.freeze: all 18 controls SHA-sealed before selector profiling
rules: do not intentionally optimize for I4H selector dimensions

evaluation.masking: deterministic SHA256 A/B swap after generation seal
evaluation.pair_rule: Treatment win if mean >= Control mean +0.30 and no hard/protection failure; Control win if reverse or Treatment protection failure; else Tie.
evaluation.same_model_claim_boundary: Same-model masked evaluation is stronger-virtual only. Numerical PASS is not independent/human evidence.

hypothesis.null: Intervention is not reliably beneficial, or gains require unacceptable fidelity/voice/social harm.
hypothesis.primary: On fresh source-free Korean drama scene briefs, the conservative I4H ABSTAIN-first -> reliability -> LOW/STANDARD policy improves intervened-scene craft without damaging semantic fidelity, speaker authorization, voice, or social texture.
hypothesis.subtext: Scenes with latent relational subtext can benefit from additive playable physicalization without deleting character-bearing dialogue.

pass_hold_fail.same_model_promotion_boundary: Even if numerical gates PASS, status is at most PASS_STRONGER_VIRTUAL_CRAFT_SIGNAL__PROMOTION_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_OR_PHYSICAL_REPLICATION.
pass_hold_fail.subtext_gate: if >=3 LOW interventions with physicalizable_subtext>=2, at least 2/3 nonloss and none >1.0 voice drop
pass_hold_fail.voice_guard: mean voice_specificity delta >= -0.25; no intervention voice drop >1.0 attributable to compression

purpose: Obtain a clean stronger-virtual prospective craft signal after R1 input contamination was stopped before generation. This does not establish OpenAI Live parity, human-writer equivalence, whole-episode competitiveness, CP1 closure, Production promotion, or Formal R140.

sample.construction: Researcher-authored neutral structural scenarios containing only invented settings, P1..Pn identities, goals, facts, relation/status, required turn, and carry-forward pressure. No scene is assigned an expected intervention mode.

decision_rule: ABSTAIN if max(social_texture,voice_specificity)>=3 and exposition_risk<=2 unless physicalizable_subtext==3 and proposed edit is additive LOW
STANDARD if exposition_risk>=2 and procedural_pressure>=2 and max(social_texture,voice_specificity)<=1 and already_playable<=1
LOW if physicalizable_subtext>=2 or exposition_risk>=2, unless STANDARD

LOW: do not delete character-bearing dialogue merely to shorten
STANDARD: may restructure action/dialogue for information economy
